title: The Jellyfish That Can Reverse Its Age
description: Turritopsis dohrnii, the immortal jellyfish, can revert to the polyp stage after reaching sexual maturity when stressed, hurt, sick or old. In theory this can go on indefinitely, so it is called biologically immortal, but in practice most individuals still die from predation or disease. It is an important target of aging research. Source: Wikipedia, Turritopsis dohrnii.
